_comment: Pictures shown under the films. t = when the picture starts showing (main and cwt: year; c228: day number, 0 = Feb 27, 1 = Feb 28, 2 = Mar 1 ...). file = exact file name on Wikimedia Commons. After editing run python tools/fetch_images.py. Feature pages use at = the clip id (p<phase>, e<event>) at which the picture starts showing.

main.zh: 歐洲人筆下的福爾摩沙人。達波（Olfert Dapper）1670 年著作中的銅版畫，畫的是想像多於寫實。
main.en: Formosans as Europeans imagined them: an engraving from Olfert Dapper’s book of 1670.

main.zh: 熱蘭遮城與大員市鎮，芬伯翁斯（Johannes Vingboons）約 1635 年繪。
main.en: Fort Zeelandia and the town of Tayouan, painted by Johannes Vingboons about 1635.

main.zh: 荷蘭人向鄭成功投降。1675 年荷蘭出版品中的版畫，出自當時歐洲人的想像。
main.en: The Dutch surrender to Koxinga, an engraving from a Dutch book of 1675, drawn as Europeans imagined the scene.

main.zh: 《康熙臺灣輿圖》局部，約 1700 年前後繪製，畫出村社、河流與山。
main.en: A detail of the Kangxi Map of Taiwan, drawn around 1700, showing villages, rivers and hills.

main.zh: 平埔族人捕鹿。清代巡台御史六十七約 1740 年代命人繪製的《番社采風圖》。
main.en: Plains Indigenous hunters chasing deer, from an album of village life painted for a Qing censor in the 1740s.

main.file: A view of the north gate tower and a portion of the streets of Taipeh.jpg
main.zh: 台北城北門與城內街道。城牆 1884 年完工，照片為 1895 年日本陸地測量部所攝。
main.en: The North Gate of Taipei and the streets inside the wall, finished in 1884; photographed by the Japanese army survey in 1895.

main.file: The 5th Regiment of Japanese Army resting in near the north gate of Taipeh.jpg
main.zh: 1895 年，日軍在台北城北門附近休息。日本陸地測量部攝。
main.en: Japanese troops resting near Taipei’s North Gate in 1895; photographed by the army survey.

main.file: Opening ceremony of the Jukan Railway Line at Taichu Park.jpg
main.zh: 1908 年 10 月，縱貫鐵路全線通車典禮在台中公園舉行。
main.en: October 1908: the ceremony at Taichung Park for the completed West Coast railway.

main.file: 文化協會第一屆理事會 (cropped).jpg
main.zh: 台灣文化協會第一回理事會合影，1926 年。
main.en: The first board meeting of the Taiwan Cultural Association, 1926.

main.zh: 台北劍潭山上的臺灣神社，1933 年。皇民化時期，神社參拜成為動員的一環。
main.en: Taiwan Shrine on the hill at Jiantan, Taipei, 1933. Shrine visits became part of wartime assimilation.

main.zh: 1945 年 10 月 25 日受降典禮當天，聚集在台北公會堂外的民眾。
main.en: October 25, 1945: the crowd outside Taipei City Public Auditorium on the day of the surrender ceremony.

main.zh: 1947 年 2 月 28 日，民眾聚集在專賣局台北分局前，焚燒局內的物品。
main.en: February 28, 1947: a crowd outside the Monopoly Bureau’s Taipei branch, burning goods from the building.

main.zh: 1949 年 5 月的戒嚴令。台灣省政府與台灣省警備總司令部布告。
main.en: The martial law order of May 1949, issued by the provincial government and the Taiwan Garrison Command.

main.zh: 1987 年 7 月，總統蔣經國公布的解嚴令。
main.en: The order lifting martial law, promulgated by President Chiang Ching-kuo in July 1987.

main.zh: 1990 年 3 月，野百合學運。學生靜坐要求國會全面改選。
main.en: March 1990: the Wild Lily student movement. Students sat in to demand a fully elected legislature.

c228.zh: 黃榮燦木刻版畫《恐怖的檢查》，1947 年。畫的是 2 月 27 日天馬茶房前的緝菸衝突。
c228.en: Huang Rong-can’s woodcut The Terrible Inspection (1947), showing the cigarette raid of February 27.

c228.zh: 2 月 28 日，民眾聚集在專賣局台北分局前，焚燒局內的物品。
c228.en: February 28: a crowd outside the Monopoly Bureau’s Taipei branch, burning goods from the building.

c228.file: 二二八事件處理委員會要求陳儀承諾縣市長直接民選 Taiwanese People asked for People-elected Mayors after the 228 Incident in 1947 (cropped).png
c228.zh: 1947 年 3 月上旬的《台灣新生報》：陳儀廣播，承諾長官公署改為省政府、縣市長 7 月 1 日民選。幾天後援軍登陸。
c228.en: Taiwan Shin Sheng Daily News, early March 1947: Chen Yi’s broadcast promising a provincial government and elected mayors from July 1. Days later the troops landed.

c228.zh: 律師湯德章，3 月 13 日在台南民生綠園遭公開槍決。
c228.en: Lawyer Tang De-zhang, shot in public in Tainan on March 13.

c228.zh: 陳儀 3 月 20 日發布的《為實施清鄉告民眾書》。
c228.en: Chen Yi’s proclamation of March 20 announcing the purges.

c228.zh: 陳澄波〈夏日街景〉，1927 年，畫的是嘉義街頭。1947 年 3 月 25 日，他在嘉義車站前遭槍決。
c228.en: Chen Cheng-po, Summer Street (1927), a street in Chiayi. He was shot in front of Chiayi Station on March 25, 1947.

cwt.zh: 1949 年 5 月的戒嚴令。台灣省政府與台灣省警備總司令部布告。
cwt.en: The martial law order of May 1949, issued by the provincial government and the Taiwan Garrison Command.

cwt.zh: 台北馬場町紀念公園。1950 年代，這片河濱是槍決政治犯的刑場。
cwt.en: Machangding Memorial Park, Taipei. In the 1950s this riverbank was the execution ground for political prisoners.

cwt.zh: 綠島新生訓導處。國家人權博物館提供。
cwt.en: The New Life Correction Center on Green Island. Photo: National Human Rights Museum.

cwt.zh: 胡適與雷震，1959 年。隔年雷震因籌組反對黨入獄十年。
cwt.en: Hu Shih and Lei Chen, 1959. A year later Lei was jailed for ten years for trying to found an opposition party.

cwt.zh: 新店景美的軍法處看守所，今日的白色恐怖景美紀念園區。
cwt.en: The military detention center at Jingmei, Xindian, today a White Terror memorial park.

cwt.file: 綠洲山莊監獄 Lüdao Lodge (Oasis Villa) prison of TAIWAN.jpg
cwt.zh: 綠島的國防部感訓監獄「綠洲山莊」，1972 年啟用。
cwt.en: Oasis Villa, the Defense Ministry prison on Green Island, opened in 1972.

cwt.zh: 1987 年 7 月，總統蔣經國公布的解嚴令。
cwt.en: The order lifting martial law, promulgated by President Chiang Ching-kuo in July 1987.

cwt.zh: 鄭南榕胸像。1989 年，他為爭取百分之百的言論自由自焚。
cwt.en: A bust of Nylon Deng, who set himself on fire in 1989 for complete freedom of speech.

cwt.zh: 台北凱達格蘭大道旁的白色恐怖政治受難者紀念碑，2008 年落成。
cwt.en: The memorial to the victims of the White Terror on Ketagalan Boulevard, Taipei, unveiled in 2008.

dutch.zh: 大員：沙洲上的熱蘭遮城與市鎮，出自布勞—范德漢地圖集，繪於 1644 年之後。
dutch.en: Tayouan: Fort Zeelandia and its town on the sandbar, from the Atlas Blaeu–Van der Hem, drawn after 1644.

dutch.zh: 熱蘭遮城與大員市鎮，芬伯翁斯（Johannes Vingboons）約 1635 年繪。
dutch.en: Fort Zeelandia and the town of Tayouan, painted by Johannes Vingboons about 1635.

dutch.file: Description of the Dutch port on Formosa Island (Taiwan), drawing 1626.jpg
dutch.zh: 西班牙人 1626 年所繪的大員港與荷蘭人據點（Pedro de Vera）。
dutch.en: The Dutch harbour at Tayouan as a Spaniard, Pedro de Vera, drew it in 1626.

dutch.zh: 歐洲人筆下的福爾摩沙人。達波（Olfert Dapper）1670 年著作中的銅版畫，畫的是想像多於寫實。
dutch.en: Formosans as Europeans imagined them: an engraving from Olfert Dapper’s book of 1670.

dutch.zh: 平埔族人捕鹿。這是一百年後清代《番社采風圖》的畫面，荷蘭時期的鹿皮就來自這樣的獵場。
dutch.en: Plains Indigenous hunters chasing deer. The painting is from a Qing album a century later; the deerskins of the Dutch era came from hunts like this.

dutch.zh: 荷蘭人向鄭成功投降。1675 年荷蘭出版品中的版畫，出自當時歐洲人的想像。
dutch.en: The Dutch surrender to Koxinga, an engraving from a Dutch book of 1675, drawn as Europeans imagined the scene.

koxinga.zh: 鄭成功畫像，國立臺灣博物館藏。
koxinga.en: Portrait of Koxinga, National Taiwan Museum.

koxinga.zh: 大員：沙洲上的熱蘭遮城與市鎮，出自布勞—范德漢地圖集（1644 年之後）。鄭軍繞過這裡，從北邊的鹿耳門水道進入內海。
koxinga.en: Tayouan: Fort Zeelandia and its town on the sandbar, from the Atlas Blaeu–Van der Hem (after 1644). Zheng’s fleet went around it, entering the lagoon by the Luermen channel to the north.

koxinga.zh: 圍城中的熱蘭遮城。參戰的瑞士傭兵赫波特（Albrecht Herport）所繪，1669 年出版。
koxinga.en: Fort Zeelandia under siege, drawn by Albrecht Herport, a Swiss soldier who was there; published in 1669.

koxinga.zh: 荷蘭人向鄭成功投降。1675 年荷蘭出版品中的版畫，出自當時歐洲人的想像。
koxinga.en: The Dutch surrender to Koxinga, an engraving from a Dutch book of 1675, drawn as Europeans imagined the scene.

yiwei.file: Scene of signing Treaty of Shimonoseki pictorial.jpg
yiwei.zh: 馬關條約簽訂的場面，約 1895 年的日本畫報。
yiwei.en: The signing of the Treaty of Shimonoseki, from a Japanese pictorial of about 1895.

yiwei.zh: 台灣民主國的藍地黃虎旗（摹本局部）。
yiwei.en: The Blue Ground Yellow Tiger Flag of the Republic of Formosa (detail of a copy).

yiwei.file: Prince Kitashirakawa Yoshihisa camping on the coast of Aodi.jpg
yiwei.zh: 1895 年 5 月 31 日，北白川宮能久親王與近衛師團在澳底海岸露營。
yiwei.en: May 31, 1895: Prince Kitashirakawa and the Imperial Guard camped on the shore at Aodi.

yiwei.file: A view of the north gate tower and a portion of the streets of Taipeh.jpg
yiwei.zh: 台北城北門。1895 年 6 月日軍未經戰鬥由此入城；照片為同年日本陸地測量部所攝。
yiwei.en: The North Gate of Taipei, where Japanese troops entered without a fight in June 1895; photographed that year by the army survey.

yiwei.file: The 5th Regiment of Japanese Army resting in near the north gate of Taipeh.jpg
yiwei.zh: 1895 年，日軍在台北城北門附近休息。日本陸地測量部攝。
yiwei.en: Japanese troops resting near Taipei’s North Gate in 1895; photographed by the army survey.

yiwei.file: The landing of Japanese troops at Fangliao.jpg
yiwei.zh: 1895 年 10 月 11 日，日軍在枋寮登陸。小川一真攝。
yiwei.en: October 11, 1895: Japanese troops landing at Fangliao. Photo by Ogawa Kazumasa.

yiwei.zh: 黑旗軍首領劉永福，約 1885 年。
yiwei.en: Liu Yongfu, leader of the Black Flag Army, about 1885.

tapani.zh: 余清芳，1915 年被捕後所攝。
tapani.en: Yu Qingfang, photographed after his arrest in 1915.
Luo Jun after his arrest in 1915.

tapani.zh: 余清芳以「大元帥」名義發布的告示，1915 年。
tapani.en: The proclamation Yu Qingfang issued as “Grand Marshal”, 1915.

tapani.zh: 事件後的照片：西來庵與遭破壞的房舍，1915 年。
tapani.en: After the rising: Xilai Temple and wrecked buildings, 1915.

tapani.file: 余清芳等人被押解經過台南停車場前.jpg
tapani.zh: 余清芳等人被押解，經過台南車站前。
tapani.en: Yu Qingfang and others being escorted past Tainan Station.

tapani.zh: 1915 年，被告從台南監獄被押往臨時法院出庭。
tapani.en: 1915: defendants marched from Tainan Prison to the special court.

wushe.file: Mona Rudao and Seediq tribal leaders.jpg
wushe.zh: 莫那．魯道（中）與賽德克族頭目，1930 年以前。
wushe.en: Mona Rudao (centre) with Seediq leaders, before 1930.

wushe.file: The scene of the Wushe Incident.JPG
wushe.zh: 事件後的霧社現場，1930 年 10 月。
wushe.en: The scene at Musha after the attack, October 1930.

wushe.file: People of the Taichu Prefecture Police Department during the Musha Incident 1930.jpg
wushe.zh: 霧社事件期間的台中州警務部人員，1930 年。
wushe.en: Staff of the Taichū Prefecture police department during the Musha Incident, 1930.

wushe.file: Smoke and flames at Truwan during Musha Incident.jpg
wushe.zh: 鎮壓期間，塔洛灣社一帶冒出濃煙與火光，1930 年。
wushe.en: Smoke and flames at Truwan during the suppression, 1930.

airraids.file: Japanese airfield on Formosa under attack by U.S. carrier aircraft, in October 1944.jpg
airraids.zh: 1944 年 10 月，台灣的日軍機場遭美國航艦飛機攻擊。美國海軍攝。
airraids.en: October 1944: a Japanese airfield on Taiwan under attack by US carrier aircraft. US Navy photo.

airraids.file: A Japanese transport explodes after being hit by carrier plane bombs in Takao Harbor, Formosa, on 15 January 1945.jpg
airraids.zh: 1945 年 1 月 15 日，高雄港內一艘日本運輸船被航艦飛機炸中爆炸。
airraids.en: January 15, 1945: a Japanese transport explodes in Takao (Kaohsiung) harbour after a hit from carrier aircraft.

airraids.zh: 1945 年 5 月 31 日台北大空襲的空拍照。美國空軍歷史研究局。
airraids.en: The Raid on Taipei from the air, May 31, 1945. US Air Force Historical Research Agency.

airraids.file: Ruins after the bombardment in Taihoku 1945.jpg
airraids.zh: 空襲後的台北街頭廢墟，1945 年。鄧南光攝。
airraids.en: Ruins in Taipei after the bombing, 1945. Photo by Deng Nan-guang.

guo.zh: 熱蘭遮城與大員市鎮，約 1635 年。1652 年荷蘭人就是從這裡渡海到對岸的赤崁救援。
guo.en: Fort Zeelandia and Tayouan, about 1635. In 1652 the Dutch crossed from here to relieve Saccam on the far shore.

guo.zh: 歐洲人筆下的福爾摩沙人（達波，1670 年）。荷蘭靠新港社等原住民盟軍平定起事。
guo.en: Formosans as Europeans drew them (Dapper, 1670). The Dutch relied on Indigenous allies such as Sinkan to put down the rising.

linshuangwen.zh: 《平定臺灣得勝圖》之一，乾隆朝為紀念平定林爽文事件所製的銅版畫，約 1793 年。
linshuangwen.en: From The Pacification of Taiwan, copperplate prints made for the Qianlong court to celebrate the suppression of Lin Shuangwen, about 1793.

linshuangwen.file: NTMoFA - Pacification of Taiwan (I) - Zhuluo Siege - Google Arts and Culture.jpg
linshuangwen.zh: 《平定臺灣得勝圖》：解諸羅之圍。
linshuangwen.en: The Pacification of Taiwan: the relief of Zhuluo.

linshuangwen.file: Crossing the ocean and triumphant return.jpg
linshuangwen.en: The Pacification of Taiwan: crossing the sea and returning in triumph.

linshuangwen.zh: 《平定臺灣得勝圖》：攻克小半天山。
linshuangwen.en: The Pacification of Taiwan: the attack on Xiaobantian mountain.

linshuangwen.file: Capture of the rebel chief Lin Shuangwen.jpg
linshuangwen.zh: 《平定臺灣得勝圖》：生擒林爽文。
linshuangwen.en: The Pacification of Taiwan: the capture of Lin Shuangwen.

daichaochun.file: A building of Wufeng Lin Family Mansion and Garden.jpg
daichaochun.zh: 霧峰林家宅第，日治時期所攝。林家因協助平定戴潮春事件而崛起。
daichaochun.en: The Wufeng Lin family mansion, photographed under Japanese rule. The family rose by helping to put down the rebellion.

feuds.zh: 《康熙臺灣輿圖》局部，約 1700 年前後。移民依祖籍聚居成庄。
feuds.en: A detail of the Kangxi Map of Taiwan, about 1700. Settlers formed villages by place of origin.

feuds.file: 1920 to 1929 the Liông-san Temple in Taihoku.jpg
feuds.zh: 艋舺龍山寺，1920 年代。泉州三邑人以龍山寺為中心，頂下郊拚就發生在艋舺。
feuds.en: Longshan Temple in Bangka, 1920s. It was the centre of the Sanyi people from Quanzhou; the guild war of 1853 was fought in Bangka.

indigenous.zh: 隘勇線上的鐵絲網，1908 年。總督府蕃務課攝。
indigenous.en: Wire entanglements on the guard line, 1908. Photo by the Government-General’s aborigine affairs section.

indigenous.zh: 隘勇線上的砲台，1908 年。總督府蕃務課攝。
indigenous.en: A gun emplacement on the guard line, 1908. Photo by the Government-General’s aborigine affairs section.

indigenous.file: Sakuma Samata on the Sedan Chair 1914.jpg
indigenous.zh: 1914 年 5 月太魯閣戰役，總督佐久間左馬太乘轎隨軍，圖為部隊的營地。
indigenous.en: May 1914, the Taroko war: the troops’ camp, with Governor-General Sakuma Samata travelling by sedan chair.

indigenous.zh: 布農族領袖拉荷・阿雷。

indigenous.file: Mona Rudao and Seediq tribal leaders.jpg
indigenous.zh: 莫那．魯道（中）與賽德克族頭目，1930 年以前。
indigenous.en: Mona Rudao (centre) with Seediq leaders, before 1930.

indigenous.file: Raho Ari and a Japanese educational inspector.jpg
indigenous.zh: 1933 年，拉荷・阿雷與日本視學官合影。
indigenous.en: 1933: Lahu Ali with a Japanese education inspector.

poj.zh: 麥都思（左）與助手，1838 年的版畫（George Baxter）。
poj.en: Walter Henry Medhurst (left) with his assistants, a print of 1838 by George Baxter.

poj.file: Cover of Introduction to Amoy Alphabets (Tn̂g-uē huan-jī tshoo-ha̍k).jpg
poj.zh: 打馬字《唐話番字初學》封面，1852 年。
poj.en: The cover of Talmage’s primer, Tn̂g-oē Hoan-jī Chho͘-ha̍k, 1852.

poj.zh: 羅啻《翻譯英華廈腔語彙》扉頁，1853 年。
poj.en: The frontispiece of Doty’s Anglo-Chinese Manual, 1853.

poj.file: 英國長老教會第一位駐臺灣宣教師馬雅各牧師（James Laidlaw Maxwell, MD).jpg
poj.zh: 馬雅各（James Laidlaw Maxwell），英國長老教會第一位駐台灣的宣教師。
poj.en: James Laidlaw Maxwell, the English Presbyterian Church’s first missionary in Taiwan.

poj.zh: 《台灣府城教會報》創刊號，1885 年 7 月，全用白話字。
poj.en: The first issue of the Tâi-oân-hú-siâⁿ Kàu-hōe-pò, July 1885, entirely in POJ.

poj.zh: 蔡培火《十項管見》（Cha̍p-hāng Koán-kiàn），1925 年。

poj.file: Cover page of Tâi-oân Kàu-hōe Kong-pò 1937-12.jpg
poj.zh: 《台灣教會公報》1937 年 12 月號封面。四年多之後被迫停刊。
poj.en: The cover of the Taiwan Church News for December 1937. A little over four years later it was forced to stop.

poj.zh: 台灣省政府 1955 年禁止教會使用羅馬字拼音的公文。
poj.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government’s 1955 order forbidding churches to use romanization.

poj.zh: 幾種台語聖經，紅色封面的是「紅皮聖經」。戴開世攝，2008 年。
poj.en: Bibles in Taiwanese; the one with the red cover is the “Red Cover Bible”. Photo by Kaihsu Tai, 2008.

poj.file: Books which use the Pe̍h-ōe-jī romanisation system for Southern Min-Taiwanese.jpg

missionaries.file: 英國長老教會第一位駐臺灣宣教師馬雅各牧師（James Laidlaw Maxwell, MD).jpg
missionaries.zh: 馬雅各（James Laidlaw Maxwell），英國長老教會第一位駐台灣的宣教師。
missionaries.en: James Laidlaw Maxwell, the English Presbyterian Church’s first missionary in Taiwan.

missionaries.zh: 今日的台南新樓醫院，前身是馬雅各 1869 年設在二老口的「舊樓」醫館。
missionaries.en: Sin-Lau Hospital in Tainan today; it grew out of the “Old Building” clinic Maxwell opened in 1869.

missionaries.zh: 甘為霖（William Campbell），19 世紀末的版畫。
missionaries.en: William Campbell, an engraving of the late nineteenth century.

missionaries.file: Teeth extraction by Rev. George Leslie Mackay and his assistants in Taiwan.jpg
missionaries.zh: 馬偕（右）與學生在野外替人拔牙。
missionaries.en: Mackay (right) and his students pulling teeth in the open air.

missionaries.file: Portrait photo of Dr. Thomas Barclay 1936.jpg
missionaries.zh: 巴克禮（Thomas Barclay）。照片刊於 1936 年。
missionaries.en: Thomas Barclay; the photograph was published in 1936.

missionaries.file: View at Tainan Theological College and Seminary.jpg
missionaries.zh: 台南神學院一景，約 1940 年。
